row.evidence: QuickBooks Online's pricing page lists Simple Start ($38/mo, 1 user), Essentials ($85/mo, 3 users), Plus ($140/mo, 5 users) and Advanced ($340/mo, 25 users) with user permissions but no SSO, SAML or SCIM; Okta's QuickBooks app is SWA only.
row.notes: Downgraded from none to unknown for rule compliance, not because anything changed: quickbooks.intuit.com and developer.intuit.com block both curl and the headless renderer, so the pricing page, Advanced page and help-centre account-management index were read only via WebFetch and the Intuit developer API reference could not be loaded (the none-by-absence rule needs the API reference). Nothing found mentions SSO, SAML or SCIM, and Okta's OIN QuickBooks app is SWA only, so June's 'none' is likely still right. Prices changed since June: Simple Start $38, Essentials $85, Plus $140, Advanced $340 per month (Advanced was $275); all show a 50%-off-for-3-months promo. Team plan changed from Simple Start (1 user) to Essentials (3 users). Flat per-company pricing, so per-user fields are null.

scim.notes: No SCIM, SSO or SAML mention on the pricing page, the Advanced page or the help-centre account-management index (read via WebFetch). The Intuit developer API reference could not be loaded, so absence is not fully established.

okta.notes: OIN QuickBooks app marks SWA only.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial found (quickbooks-online-tutorial, quickbooks-tutorial, intuit-quickbooks-tutorial return 404).
